def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(input[0])
    a = list(map(int, input[1:n+1]))
    count1 = a.count(1)
    count2 = a.count(2)
    res = 0
    res += count2 // 2
    remaining2 = count2 % 2
    if remaining2 == 1:
        count1 -= 1
    res += count1 // 3
    res += min(count1 % 3, remaining2 * 2)
    print(res)

main()
